judgments.printed_text: 2. A corporation which has as its principal business the holding of investments and is wholly owned by one or more SPIs may be treated the same as the SPIs for the purpose of this guidance.
judgments.explanation: Both occurrences read “SPIs”, consistent with the abbreviation defined in the opening paragraph. “SPls” substitutes a lowercase l for the uppercase I, changing the abbreviation rather than merely its typography. The sans-serif glyphs are visually similar, but the visible definition and repeated usage support this transcription.
judgments.affected_condition: Paragraph 2 permits the stated treatment for a corporation whose principal business is holding investments and which is wholly owned by one or more SPIs.
